content: uPlot has no built-in heatmap mark (time-series/line/bar/ohlc only); ECharts canvas renderer is recommended by its own docs for >1k elements but published benchmark suites report ECharts and Highcharts heatmap tests not completing past ~200 grid points, i.e. degrading badly well below 10k cells. Custom canvas/WebGL heatmap implementations (simpleheat, hotmap/pixi.js) scale to millions of cells.
